chapters.title: Not a spirit of fear
chapters.summary: Paul remembers Timothy's sincere faith, passed down from his grandmother and mother. God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love and a sound mind.

chapters.title: A good soldier
chapters.summary: Endure hardship like a good soldier. If we are faithless, He remains faithful. Rightly handle the word of truth and pursue righteousness.

chapters.title: All Scripture is inspired
chapters.summary: Difficult times will come. Continue in what you have learned: all Scripture is given by inspiration of God and is profitable for teaching and training in righteousness.

chapters.title: I have finished the race
chapters.summary: Preach the word in season and out of season. Near death, Paul writes: I have fought a good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith.
